citations.quote: Standard I(D) addresses all conduct that reflects poorly on the professional integrity, good reputation, or competence of members and candidates.
The integrity of the investment profession is built on trust.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard I.D prohibits any professional conduct involving dishonesty, fraud, or deceit and any act that reflects adversely on professional reputation, integrity, or competence; the residual-reputation prong reaches lying/cheating/stealing, fraudulent bankruptcy, and business-hours intoxication, while carving out private morality absent a professional nexus.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard I(D) Misconduct
